socket.title: Socket URL
socket.description: Optional URL to a socket.io server that emits Ruuvitag data. If not provided, direct Bluetooth discovery will be used.

tags.title: Ruuvitag Devices
tags.description: Configure Ruuvitag sensors to include in Homebridge

id.title: Ruuvitag ID
id.description: The MAC address or ID of the Ruuvitag sensor

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name for this sensor in HomeKit (defaults to ID if not provided)

disableTemp.title: Disable Temperature
disableTemp.description: Set to true to disable the temperature sensor

disableHumidity.title: Disable Humidity
disableHumidity.description: Set to true to disable the humidity sensor

frequency.title: Update Frequency
frequency.description: Minimum time between updates in seconds (0 means update on every change)

heatTrigger.title: Heat Trigger
heatTrigger.description: Configure a contact sensor that triggers when temperature exceeds a threshold

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name for the heat trigger (defaults to sensor name)

coldTrigger.title: Cold Trigger
coldTrigger.description: Configure a contact sensor that triggers when temperature falls below a threshold

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name for the cold trigger (defaults to sensor name)

highHumidityTrigger.title: High Humidity Trigger
highHumidityTrigger.description: Configure a contact sensor that triggers when humidity exceeds a threshold

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name for the high humidity trigger (defaults to sensor name)

lowHumidityTrigger.title: Low Humidity Trigger
lowHumidityTrigger.description: Configure a contact sensor that triggers when humidity falls below a threshold

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name for the low humidity trigger (defaults to sensor name)

motionTrigger.title: Motion Trigger
motionTrigger.description: Configure a motion sensor that detects movement of the Ruuvitag

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name for the motion trigger (defaults to sensor name)
